{{Short description|Norwegian physicist}}
'''Olav Holt''' (7 January 1935 – 7 February 2021) was a Norwegian physicist.

Holt was born in [[Hedrum Municipality]], and took his [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1963. Holt is a specialist in the upper atmosphere physics and radio wave propagation in the ionosphere.

Later, Holt was hired as professor at the [[University of Tromsø]] in 1969, where he served as [[Rector (academia)|rector]] from 1973 to 1977.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|title=Olav Holt|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |publisher=|location= |url=http://www.snl.no/Olav_Holt|access-date=28 August 2024}}</ref> He is a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ntva.no/index.php?option=com_club&view=member&id=199%3Aholt-olav&Itemid=60|title=Medlemmer: HOLT, Olav|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=29 November 2012}}</ref> In 2003 he was proclaimed Knight, First Class of the [[Royal Norwegian Order of St. Olav]].{{Citation needed|date=February 2009}}

His wife is Tordis Holt and he is the father of the Norwegian bestselling author and former Minister of Justice [[Anne Holt]],<ref name=snl/> and the Cardiologist Dr.med. Even Holt.
